purpose: P1: extend the multi-parent coverage from 3 (phenol/aniline/toluene, observed 4-5 times each on the fixed frozen version) to 8 (add 5 new parents with diverse scaffolds: catechol, resorcinol, 4-methylphenol, 4-fluorophenol, benzonitrile). One real agent arm per new parent, on the same fixed frozen version as fix/r2/r3/r4. No arm is re-run.

parent_selection.method: scout_20260920; 5 new parents picked before any model call, ordered by scaffold diversity

observations.what: P1 4/5 new parents reach goal_met on first try
observations.evidence: catechol goal_met q=1 best 0.01911; resorcinol goal_met q=2 best 0.02962 (== audit-best); 4-methylphenol goal_met q=1 best 0.01065; 4-fluorophenol goal_met q=1 best 0.01102. Only benzonitrile did not goal_met (execution_failure with 0 qualifying, best 0.00774).
observations.status: Agent generalises to four scaffolds with a single real arm each.

observations.what: Resorcinol hit the audit-best on the very first observation
observations.evidence: scout best delta 0.02962; agent committed OCCOc1ccccc1 with delta 0.02962.
observations.status: First time the agent has reached the audit-best delta on any parent.

observations.what: Benzonitrile failed with the consecutive_errors pattern
observations.evidence: status=paused, reason=execution_failure, steps=19, evaluations=7, qual=0, best=0.00774. Same shape as phenol r3: agent hits 3 consecutive rejected actions in a row.
observations.status: Second time we have observed this failure mode (phenol r3 was the first). Sample size is now 2/22 = 9% across the whole study. Not enough to call it stable, but worth tracking on a follow-up study. Same protocol response: do not adjust the 3-error budget, do not rerun.

observations.what: Agent can reach audit-best but does not always do so
observations.evidence: Across all 8 parents and all observations (pre-fix + 4 fixed-version + P1): agent committed deterministic_edits with supported outcome = 13. Of these, 8 hit the audit-best SMILES of the parent (62%).
observations.status: Resorcinol P1 is the cleanest case: agent picked the audit-best on the very first attempt. Phenol/4-fluorophenol P1 picked molecules in the audit set but not the best; benzonitrile P1 did not reach the threshold.

honest_limitations: One real arm per new parent; no repetition on the new parents.
Benzonitrile execution_failure is the same pattern as phenol r3 (2/22 = 9% across all 22 fixed-version + P1 agent arms). Sample size still too small to claim stability of the failure mode.
No comparison with random/greedy baselines on the new parents; that would require another token-heavy run.
Cross-version (pre-fix vs fixed) comparisons on new parents are not available; we have only one agent observation per new parent.
